scientific_queries.note: Per-pool correlation between the boolean criterion and the dense criterion, which overturns R129's rule.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round checks a number R129 borrowed and finds it measured something else.

my_error_in_R129.what_i_said: the boolean flag and the quartile correlate at about 0.83, so counting criteria is redundancy
my_error_in_R129.what_R128_measured: the four continuous delta metrics correlate 0.806 to 0.967 among themselves; delta AUC versus delta EMAX is 0.831
my_error_in_R129.what_it_actually_is: boolean versus quartile is 0.199 overall and 0.292 in the smallest pool
my_error_in_R129.the_conflation: a continuous-versus-continuous number carried into a boolean-versus-quartile claim without measuring it
my_error_in_R129.severity: the R129 rule inverts the correct reading

the_two_correct_facts.continuous_metrics_redundant: 0.806 to 0.967 - four scalings of one readout, so the objective's independent-endpoint requirement remains unmet
the_two_correct_facts.the_two_criteria_independent: rho about 0.20 with Jaccard 0.06 to 0.12 - they index different things, so multi-criteria phrasing was substantially right

disposition.withdrawn: the CRITERION_REDUNDANCY rule in the register, synthesis and audit, plus the C98 sentence claiming the criteria were never independent
disposition.retained: C98's finding that the four continuous delta metrics are not independent endpoints
disposition.added: C99 records the corrected correlation and its consequences
disposition.unaffected: the frozen claim, which rests on the dense criterion plus random, permuted and dead-block controls

the_seventh_over_correction.pattern: R99, R102, R119, R120, R129 - each time a number was generalised immediately after being obtained
the_seventh_over_correction.new_standing_rule: any number reused across tables or rounds must state which two quantities it relates; otherwise it may not be reused

limits: pool masks are key-level and keys are not independent within a cell or a drug
low Jaccard does not mean fully independent, since both derive from the same dose-response matrix
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: keep the corrected contrast (0.20 between criteria, 0.9 between metrics) visible in the register so the two numbers are not mixed again

register_updates.C99: new: the two criteria are largely independent

mutations_outside_episode: research/EVIDENCE_REGISTER.md (C99 added, rule replaced, C98/C74 corrected)
